chunks: Let them then attend to their persons and complete the rites of pilgrimage, fulfil their vows and circuit round the ancient House.

key_terms.تَفَثَهُمْ: Personal grooming (removing hair and nails) after Ihram

ai.seo_question: What are the final rituals of Hajj mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the culmination of Hajj rites, where 'Tafath' (removing impurities like hair and nails) symbolizes the purification of the self after spiritual exertion. The command to fulfill vows (Nudhur) highlights the importance of keeping promises to Allah as a sign of sincerity, while Tawaf al-Ifadah serves as the final act of devotion before concluding the pilgrimage.
